Container.Name: Trackside
Container.Overview: Trackside is a self-hosted music server for the Tracks app. It indexes the music you own and serves it to Tracks and to any Subsonic or OpenSubsonic app (Amperfy, Symfonium, Feishin and others), with accounts for everyone in the house, listens, favourites and playlists. After the first start, open the container log for the setup token, then go to the web UI to create the admin account. The music share is mounted read-only.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Web dashboard, native API and Subsonic API.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, keys, backups and caches. Keep it on a pool or cache drive, not on a network share.

Config.Name: Music
Config.Description: Your music. Becomes the first library on the first start.

Config.Name: Addresses for Tracks
Config.Description: Comma-separated addresses Tracks should try, for example http://192.168.1.20:4747 or your Tailscale address. Bridge networking hides the server's LAN address, so set at least that one for QR pairing.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for the nightly backup schedule.
